ShortDescription.Value: Adjust all Transit, Passengers, Industry Trucks + Cargo, and increase Transit Line slider limits.

Publish.LongDescription:
### All Transit + Trucks (AT+T)
### Do what you need reliably without UI bloat.
- Scale many aspects for: - all Public Transit + Passengers - Industry Delivery vehicles, Cargo stations, Extractors. - Parks/Roads Maintenance - Everything is OPTIONAL
**Industry deliveries can use the increased vehicle capacities you set, including company shopping and road storage transfers.**
### Features - Transit Line adjuster: can allow as low as 1 bus or higher ~30-60 buses (tram, train, etc.). - **Parks + Roads Repairs**: fleet size, work shift + rate - Road wear (beta): scale speed roads accumulate damage over time - **Industry Deliveries**: capacity of Semi trucks, delivery vans/motorbike, Raw material trucks (coal, oil...) - **Total vehicles per facility:** Extractors, warehouses, and industrial Processing (Fish, Oil, etc.). - *Cargo Stations*: max active trucks (harbor/train/airport) - **Industry compatibility toggle:** restores Extractor, Warehouse, and Industry fleets to vanilla.
#### Public Transit
- **Transit depots:** change max vehicles per depot (Bus, Ferry, Subway, Taxi, Tram, Train) - **Passengers:** change maximum seats (Bus, Tram, Train, Subway, Ship, Ferry, Airplane) - Includes everything from *Adjust Transit Capacity* (ATC) mod plus all new mods above are *combined* into one mod.
### Notes 🚍🚋🚆✈️🚢 - *Remove* "Adjust Transit Capacity" if you install this mod. - Avoid other depot/passenger capacity mods to avoid conflicts (they override each other). - No Harmony patch used, more compatible - less likely to break on patch days. - Safe to remove any time (use Reset buttons to return to vanilla game default values). - ✅ Transit Line checkbox: Pick only one mod to adjust this - Don't use other mods that also adjust the in-game slider. There may be conflicts if you also have Transit Policy Adjuster or Smart transportation. If both are enabled, it's not going to explode, it may be inconsistent like two people changing the radio station. - How Transit lines is different: follows the game’s method (travel time + stops); you can have just 1 bus per line or ~30-60+ buses (see before/after screenshot).
### Support and feedback - please don't forget to give it a Like button (top right). - All details not above might be answered in forums or in tool tips of the mod menu. - Feedback on: Github, Discord links on this page (right side).
### Credits - River-Mochi: author - yenyang: code review and testing. - The Transit section is inspired by Wayz's original Depot Capacity Changer. - Nukprach, BugsyG, Necko1996: testing
### Performance advantage Designed to *not* run in the city per-frame. It only runs when a change is made in the Options Menu, then the mod goes idle - simple, no city impact.
Most changes apply only when a city loads or you change Options, then ATT goes idle.
### 12+ Languages Supported - Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski - Português Brasileiro, Português (Portugal), Türkçe - 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Tiếng Việt
